# v0.14: two bounded read-only capabilities

The nineteen-tool bridge appends exactly three tools after all sixteen unchanged
complete v0.13 contracts:

- `calculate_formal_exterior`: one `request`, exact formal exterior calculation
  followed by independent Adams/Newton certificate checking.
- `check_formal_exterior_certificate`: separately supplied `request` and
  `certificate`, reconstructed independently without producer/fusion imports.
- `plan_validation_evidence`: one `document`, pure classification of explicit
  authored task/receipt pins. It does not read files, run argv, skip checks or
  authorize any workflow action.

The frozen accepted implementations are preserved byte-for-byte in
`exterior_power` and `validation_receipt`. Their full pinned lab ZIPs, source
manifests and review reports are retained. Old runtime arithmetic, ledger,
acceptance domains and all historical validation/release code remain unchanged.

## Formal mathematical scope

The exterior domain assumes the pinned physical SL2(F5) identification and a
supplied formal equivariant splitting. It computes exterior characters or formal
split-bundle exterior powers; finite H0 multiplicity comparisons apply the twist
AFTER wedge: H0((Lambda^k E)(t)), not H0(Lambda^k(E(t))). Physical W/Wp and A/V are
not interchangeable. Neither ordinary nor exterior calculations construct or
identify actual objects or maps. A negative comparison is only a necessary
conditional obstruction under independently established geometric assumptions;
a nonnegative result is not map existence or injectivity evidence.

The illustrative operands are S4 O(-1) and (W+Wp) O(-1). At t=6 their ordinary
H0 characters coincide and the second exterior target-minus-source difference is
D-P-1. At t=1 the ordinary difference is already W+Wp-S4. Thus the exterior
comparison is stronger than that one ordinary t=6 comparison, not all twists.
There is no hidden -2 shift, actual geometry, all-twist theorem, Lean proof,
proof promotion or new accepted runtime domain.

## Evidence planning is not validation execution

A planner report compares caller-authored JSON. A coherent fabricated task and
receipt set can match. Task-set completeness, honest role assignment, complete
input closure, actual runner/environment coverage, genuine execution, artifact
existence/authenticity, and freshness are external obligations. Observed access
traces do not establish closure. Unknown or missing pins block matching; the
planner does not discover a newer substitute. Mandatory fresh roles remain fresh.
Exit 0 means a valid classification, which can contain MUST_RUN_FRESH blockers.
Every report explicitly denies execution, fresh pass, skip authorization,
closure/artifact/authenticity verification, mathematical truth and proof changes.

See the preserved EXTERIOR-LAB-API.md, EXTERIOR-LAB-MATHEMATICS.md,
EXTERIOR-LAB-INDEPENDENT-REVIEW.md, RECEIPT-LAB-CONTRACT.md and
RECEIPT-LAB-INDEPENDENT-REVIEW.md for exact assumptions and independent evidence.
